newsitem.title: CHINA: French Ethypharm opens $15 million jv in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: French Ethypharm opens $15 million jv in Shanghai.

text.p: China's first joint venture making medicines with a French company, Shanghai Ethypharm Pharmaceutical, has begun operating at a new factory in Shanghai, a company official said on Friday.
With total investment of $15 million and registered capital of $10 million, French Ethypharm took a 60 percent stake in the company with Shanghai Tianping Pharmaceutical, he said.
He said the company would use French technology to make drugs for heart disease and related illnesses.
French Ethypharm is number one in Europe and number two in the world using microgranule technology to make its drugs, the official said.
The China joint venture was expected to post turnover of 40 million yuan ($4.8 million) in 1997, he said.
